findings: training/train_swinir.py build_datasets uses development_patch_split on the whole root (mixes scenes) and its Kelvin metrics use the first scene's normalization stats; guarded in this task.
Degradation noise RNG is keyed by seed and scene-local patch_id only, so equal patch IDs in different scenes receive identical noise fields (not changed; same inputs for every method).

Normalized-space MAE/RMSE equal Kelvin error divided by each scene's thermal std, so they are not comparable across scenes; Kelvin metrics are. Per-patch PSNR (patch-range) is invariant to the linear normalization; SSIM constants are fixed in z-units, so SSIM depends on scene std.
Kelvin reconstruction value_K = z*std+mean is exact (up to float32 rounding) only with the patch's own scene statistics; never with pooled or another scene's statistics.
